evidence.why: Deferred branch and immediate cleanup path.

facts.rationale: Preserves the wrapper's teardown role while including the delegated routine's early-return branch.
facts.value: Forwards its HSD_GObj argument unchanged to HSD_GObjPLink_80390228. That routine can set a deferred-destruction flag and return when its scheduler guard applies; otherwise it removes userdata, the attached object, processes and any graphics link, unlinks the GObj and frees its allocation.

evidence.why: Caller delegates a selected primary tie.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported unique-best guarantee while retaining the helper's demonstrated role.
facts.value: Attempts secondary selection among entries tied on a Misc. Records primary statistic, using KO and fall comparisons and returning a selectable-character kind or SELKIND_COUNT. Its early breaks and start-index-anchored comparisons do not implement a general unique lexicographic optimum, and it performs no unlock filtering.

evidence.why: Updates, equality tests, early breaks, starting-entry filters and returns.

facts.rationale: Records literal execution order rather than normalizing it to an ideal two-key ranking algorithm.
facts.value: Starts best_idx at start_idx and scans later entries sharing the starting primary value. Mode false favors larger KO totals; mode true favors smaller totals. KO equality is checked after best_idx may have been replaced, so a replacement immediately compares the candidate with itself and breaks into the fall pass. That pass skips best_idx, requires primary equality and KO equality with start_idx, and breaks on equal falls before applying the mode-dependent preference: fewer falls for false, more for true. A marked fall tie returns SELKIND_COUNT; otherwise the current best entry's selkind is returned. Neither pass checks unlock status.

facts.rationale: Preserves all four row mappings and comparison directions while qualifying the claimed outcome.
facts.value: Supplies secondary selection for Smash Champ and Slug Meister with mode false, and Smash Sap and Punching Bag with mode true. The comparison directions favor more KOs/fewer falls for false and fewer KOs/more falls for true, but early exits and start-index filtering mean these directions are not a guarantee that the globally best secondary-stat character is displayed.

evidence.why: Descending ordering, outer filtering and delegation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that locked characters are excluded from every selection path.
facts.value: Orders selectable characters by a supplied primary statistic in descending order for Misc. Records, traverses unlocked candidates at the requested rank, and delegates a selected primary tie to mnCount_8025072C. It returns a character kind or SELKIND_COUNT. Unlock filtering belongs to the outer traversal; the delegated resolver can inspect and return locked entries.

evidence.why: Full preflight, ranking and resolver behavior.

facts.rationale: Preserves the no-history and rank-failure branches without overstating the delegated result.
facts.value: Returns SELKIND_COUNT if all selectable characters have zero play_time. After stable descending primary ordering, the outer traversal skips locked entries and consumes the rank counter, including its explicit index mutations for equal values; a tie that consumes the requested rank can return the sentinel. When the remaining rank is zero, a later unlocked equal-valued entry triggers mnCount_8025072C. That helper has no unlock filtering and its early-break comparisons do not guarantee a unique global KO/fall optimum. Exhaustion also returns SELKIND_COUNT.

evidence.why: Character helper inserts a string and adjusts font scale.

facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect fighter glyph/icon description with the canonical text-output path.
facts.value: Obtains MnCountData from the supplied GObj. visible_row selects label/value slots and their shared Y coordinate; data_row selects the SIS label and record metric. Existing text objects are replaced and the new pointers stored in those slots. Time values are formatted as hours and minutes, ordinary values as unsigned decimal text, and character results as text through gm_80160B40 after selectable-to-character-kind conversion; SELKIND_COUNT instead produces the unavailable marker.

evidence.why: Exact row arguments and availability guard.
Mode-dependent secondary comparisons and mode-independent descending primary sort.

facts.rationale: Disambiguates primary descending ordering from secondary comparison mode.
facts.value: The row selects a per-character metric and ranking path. Play-time rows use mnCount_8025035C at ranks 0, 1 or unlocked-count minus 1; Shortest Time returns SELKIND_COUNT when fewer than three characters are unlocked. Wins, losses, damage dealt and damage taken use mnCount_8025092C at rank 0, with mode controlling secondary KO/fall directions rather than primary sort direction. KO, fall and self-destruct rows use mnCount_8025035C at rank 0. The resulting character kind or sentinel flows to row rendering; unsupported rows return SELKIND_COUNT.

evidence.why: Accessor reads, count helpers and bounds.

facts.rationale: Keeps the observed accessor flow and avoids assigning an unverified average interpretation to its stored value.
facts.value: The row selects power/play timers, match totals, the value read through gmMainLib_GetVsPlayContestants, reset/damage/KO/self-destruct totals, unlocked-character or stage counts, trophy total or saved-name count. The function bounds the selected unsigned value and returns it to row rendering. It performs no contestant averaging itself. The renderer divides time results into hours and minutes and prints ordinary numeric results as unsigned decimal text.

evidence.why: Explicit time cases, defaults and saturation.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes a syntactically present fallback from a reachable numeric state.
facts.value: Recognized rows fetch their current value before saturation. Time rows are capped at 3599999940 and other rows at 999999999. The default contains a time-classified fallback of 359940 and a non-time fallback of 9999, but every row accepted by the current five-case time classifier is explicitly handled in the switch, so the time fallback is unreachable in this revision. Unsupported selectors therefore take the 9999 fallback.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact input and transition arguments without interpreting 4 as a physical controller channel.
facts.value: Retrieves MnCountData through global menu_gobj rather than its callback argument. When cooldown permits input, calls mn_80229624 with literal argument 4 and stores the result in mn_804A04F0.buttons. Accepted Up/Down input changes scroll_pos and rebuilds visible rows through menu_gobj. Back clears entering_menu and calls mn_80229894(MENU_KIND_RECORDS, 2, 3).
